title: Elliptic problems involving a diffusion operator of vectorial $p\&q$-Laplacian type
summary: We study a broad class of anisotropic Dirichlet problems driven by the nonhomogeneous operator \[ \mathcal L_Au=-\sum_{i=1}^N\partial_i\!\left( a_i(|\partial_i u|^{p_i})|\partial_i u|^{p_i-2} \partial_i u\right), \] where the functions $a_i$ satisfy structural growth and monotonicity conditions of $(p_i,q_i)$-type. This framework contains, among other examples, the anisotropic $\vec p$-Laplacian, the orthotropic $p\&q$-Laplacian, and anisotropic operators combining several directional growth regimes.
